user.title: Cattle Sprayer Mesh
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant talks to your house MeshCore radio. Prefer the Wi‑Fi gateway so the radio can sit for LoRa range while HA stays on the LAN.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi gateway
wifi.description: Use a Cattle Sprayer Mesh Wi‑Fi gateway (Xiao S3 WIO flashed with Xiao_S3_WIO_cs_gateway). Join its SoftAP CattleSprayer-GW-xxxx, open http://192.168.4.1/, enter home Wi‑Fi, then enter the gateway IP here (TCP 5000) and paste the sprayer SoftAP pairing card.

data_description.host: Shown on the gateway settings page after it joins home Wi‑Fi (or your router)
data_description.port: Always 5000 for the Cattle Sprayer gateway
data_description.pairing: Copy from a sprayer SoftAP → Network → MeshCore → Add to home

usb.title: USB companion
usb.description:
Plug a MeshCore USB radio into this Home Assistant box. Paste the SoftAP pairing card (Network → MeshCore → Add to home).

USB ports found: {ports}

data_description.serial_port: Use the path from Settings → System → Hardware → ⓘ (often /dev/ttyACM0), not Windows COM3
data_description.pairing: Copy from the sprayer SoftAP Add to home card
data_description.baud: Leave at 115200 unless your companion uses something else

error.invalid_pairing: That pairing card could not be read. Copy the full JSON from SoftAP (needs a 32-hex secret).
error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the MeshCore radio. For Wi‑Fi: check gateway IP and port 5000. For USB: Companion USB firmware, Hardware ⓘ path, nothing else using the port.

abort.already_configured: This companion is already set up
